description: A span's tokens need not lie in their text's order: an inserted token and an empty capture can have their sources before the first token's or after the last's. Here each triple X Y Z has empty text from X's source to Z's, but text() of Y Z is "a" in the first and "b" in the second, so the two triples do not share an answer (engine §4, nested parses).

documents.a.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text letter letter
%rule letter char %emits $ <"A">, $ <"A">
%rule char "a" | "b"
```
documents.b.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text pair pair
%rule pair prefix edge
%rule prefix A %emits "X"
%rule edge $n(nothing) A %emits "Y", $n <"Z">
%rule nothing ε
```
documents.c.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x(triple) $y(triple)
%conditions matches($x, probe), ¬matches($y, probe)
%rule triple X Y Z
%rule probe X $p(pair)
%conditions text($p) = "a"
%rule pair Y Z
```
